load_steps.label: Effective aspect ratio
load_steps.formula: A_e = 2 b / c (hull as a mirror)

load_steps.label: Lift slope
load_steps.note: Whicker and Fehlner (1958), low-aspect-ratio control surfaces, no sweep.

load_steps.label: Lift coefficient at the largest angle
load_steps.note: The second term is cross-flow lift, which matters at low aspect ratio.

load_steps.label: Lift, NEMO's foil model
load_steps.formula: L = ½ ρ V^2 A C_L

load_steps.label: Rudder force, IACS UR S10
load_steps.note: K_2 = 1.10 for NACA sections, K_3 = 0.8 outside the propeller jet.

load_steps.label: Twisting moment on the stock
load_steps.formula: Q = F c |0.33 − x_s/c|, at least 0.1 F c

load_steps.label: Astern speed
load_steps.note: UR S10.2.1.1: the astern speed is not to be taken less than half the ahead speed.

load_steps.label: Rudder force astern, IACS UR S10
load_steps.note: K_2 = 0.80 for NACA sections astern (UR S10 Table 1).

load_steps.label: Twisting moment astern
load_steps.note: Going astern the centre of pressure moves aft, to 0.66 of the chord (UR S10.2.1.2).

load_steps.label: Bending at the outer bearing astern

rule_set.name: IACS UR S10, Rudders, sole pieces and rudder horns (Rev.8, 2025), applied to a stabilizer fin

material.name: Shipbuilding steel AH36 (higher strength)
material.source: IACS UR W11, higher strength hull structural steel, grade AH36

stock_material.name: Forged steel 42CrMo4, quenched and tempered (stocks)
stock_material.source: EN 10083-3, 42CrMo4 (1.7225) +QT. Tensile strength is the minimum for the largest size band; check the mill certificate.

rule_set.name: IACS UR S10, Rudders, sole pieces and rudder horns (Rev.8, 2025), applied to a stabilizer fin

checks.title: Stock twisting
checks.source: IACS UR S10.4.1: torsional stress in the stock, ahead and astern
checks.explanation: The lift acts behind or ahead of the stock and twists it. Going astern the centre of pressure moves aft, so the twist can be larger at a lower speed.

checks.title: Stock bending and twisting at the outer bearing
checks.source: IACS UR S10.4.2: equivalent stress in the stock, ahead and astern
checks.explanation: Where the stock leaves the hull bearing it carries the whole bending moment from the fin as well as the twist.

working.label: Bending moment at the bearing, ahead
Bending moment at the bearing, astern

checks.title: Stock fits inside the foil
checks.source: NEMO practice
checks.explanation: The stock and its housing must fit inside the foil at the stock position, with room for the skin.

checks.title: Fin body bending at the root
checks.source: IACS UR S10.5.1: bending stress in the rudder blade
checks.explanation: The fin is a short wing fixed at the hull. Its skin and spars act as a box beam carrying the lift to the root.

working.label: Box second moment
working.substituted: skin 8 mm between 15% and 65% chord, webs 8 mm

checks.title: Spar web shear at the root
checks.source: IACS UR S10.5.1: shear stress in the rudder blade
checks.explanation: The spar webs carry the lift as shear, and the closed box carries the twist as a shear flow around it.

working.label: Shear flow from twist
working.note: Bredt's formula for a closed thin-walled section.

checks.title: Fin skin combined stress
checks.source: IACS UR S10.5.1: equivalent stress in the rudder blade
checks.explanation: The skin is bent by the lift and sheared by the twist at the same time.

checks.title: Skin plate thickness
checks.source: IACS UR S10.5.2: rudder plating
checks.explanation: The rules set a least skin thickness from the panel size between ribs and spars, the draught and the fin force.

working.label: Panel
working.formula: s = smaller, b = larger of rib pitch and spar spacing

checks.title: Spar and rib web thickness
checks.source: IACS UR S10.5.2: web plates at least 70% of the side plating and 8 mm
checks.explanation: Webs inside the fin must not be too thin compared with the skin.

checks.title: Skin panel buckling
checks.source: NEMO practice: plate buckling (Timoshenko) with Johnson-Ostenfeld correction, factor 1.5
checks.explanation: On the side being squeezed by the bending, a skin panel between ribs and spars can buckle like a thin sheet.

working.label: Buckling coefficient
working.formula: k_b = min over m of (m b/a + a/(m b))^2
working.substituted: a = 350 mm (rib pitch), b = 600 mm (spar spacing)

working.label: With plasticity
working.formula: σ_{cr} = σ_E, or F_y (1 − F_y/(4 σ_E)) above F_y/2

checks.title: Fin tip deflection
checks.source: Design limit set for this job
checks.explanation: A fin that bends too much changes its angle and loads the stock bearings unevenly.

checks.title: Cavitation at the largest fin angle
checks.source: Panel method pressure against the cavitation number
checks.explanation: If the lowest pressure on the foil falls below the vapour pressure of the water, bubbles form and collapse on the skin. It erodes the fin and adds noise. Reduce the largest angle or the speed at which it is used.

working.label: Section angle for the same lift
working.note: The 2D lift slope comes from NEMO's panel method of the NACA section.

working.label: Cavitation number
working.formula: σ = (p_a + ρ g h − p_v) / (½ ρ V^2)

fea.region: stock from 80 mm outboard of the bearing to the loaded length
fea.hand_label: stock, beam theory with bending and twist
